content:
Take this free CTET Paper 1 practice test — 10 exam-pattern maths MCQs with instant scoring and worked explanations. The CTET Paper I (Classes I–V) Mathematics section rewards candidates who practise across all chapters, not just their favourites. This free online practice test mixes questions from numbers, operations, geometry, measurement, time, money, data handling and patterns — exactly the spread you meet in the real paper.

Take the 10-question mixed test below, review every explanation, and then move to full-length practice with the 30-paper e-book at the end.

Why full-length practice matters for CTET Maths

Chapter practice builds accuracy; full papers build stamina and topic-switching. In the exam you jump from a place-value question to a clock to a bar graph in seconds, and that switching is a skill of its own.

  • Cover every chapter so no topic surprises you
  • Practise timing — the paper is as much about speed as accuracy
  • Balance content questions with pedagogy questions
  • Review solutions to fix the exact steps you miss

Learn any weak topic free on the CTET Paper I Mathematics course at vidaara.org.

Free CTET Paper 1 practice test (10 questions)

No sign-up, instant scoring. Answer all ten, then press Check my score and read the explanations.

When the mixed test shows a weak chapter, drill it with the CTET Paper 1 practice test papers e-book — 30 full papers, 900 MCQs, all solved step by step. You can also browse every chapter e-book on the CTET Paper 1 Mathematics shelf.

How to use this test well

Attempt all ten questions in one sitting. Only then check the answers. Switching between solving and checking hides your real accuracy. Read the worked explanation even for correct answers. A right answer reached the slow way still costs time in the exam hall. Note the exact step where each wrong answer went off track. Redo that question from scratch two days later. Ten honest questions teach more than fifty solved passively.

quiz.title: CTET Paper 1 Maths Mixed Practice Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten mixed CTET Paper I – pattern questions from across the syllabus. Pick an answer, then press Check my score.

questions.q: A teacher writes the numbers 789, 798, 879, 897 on the board and asks for the descending order. Which is correct?
questions.explanation: Descending means largest to smallest. All have 3 digits. Compare hundreds: 8,8,7,7. 897 and 879 are larger. Compare tens of 897 (9) and 879 (7): 9 > 7, so 897 > 879. Next come 798 and 789. Tens: 9 > 8, so 798 > 789. Full order: 897, 879, 798, 789.

questions.q: In a park, there are 156 red flowers and 178 yellow flowers. How many flowers are there in total?
questions.explanation: This is a 'combining' addition problem. Total flowers = 156 + 178 = 334.

questions.q: A rectangular chart paper has a length of 18 cm and a breadth of 12 cm. What is its area in square centimeters?
questions.explanation: Area of rectangle = Length \times Breadth = 18 \times 12 = 216\text{ cm}^2.

questions.q: What is the quotient when 315 is divided by 3?
questions.explanation: Dividing step by step: 3 \div 3 = 1 (hundreds place), 1 \div 3 = 0 (tens place), and 15 \div 3 = 5 (ones place). The quotient is 105.

questions.q: A square and a rectangle have the same perimeter. The side of the square is 8 cm. If the length of the rectangle is 10 cm, its breadth is:
questions.explanation: Perimeter of square = 4 × 8 = 32 cm. Perimeter of rectangle = 2 × (10 + b) = 32 ⇒ 10 + b = 16 ⇒ b = 6 cm.

questions.q: How many vertices (corners) does a triangle have?
questions.explanation: A triangle has 3 vertices — the same as its number of sides.

questions.q: A cricket match starts at 10:00 a.m. and ends at 5:30 p.m. There is a 45-minute lunch break. What is the actual playing time?
questions.explanation: Total time from 10:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. = 7 hours 30 minutes. Subtract the lunch break: 7 hours 30 minutes - 45 minutes = 6 hours 45 minutes. (Borrow 1 hour: 6 hours 90 minutes - 45 minutes = 6 hours 45 minutes).

questions.q: A bar graph shows the heights of saplings. The scale is: 1 unit = 2 cm. The bar for Sapling A is 4.5 units high. What is the height of Sapling A?
Express 6005 paise in standard rupee and paise format.
questions.explanation: Since 100 paise = ₹1, divide 6005 by 100: 6005 / 100 = ₹60.05 (60 Rupees and 5 Paise).

questions.q: Identify the missing alphanumeric term: Z10, Y20, X30, W40, __.
questions.explanation: The letters decrease backward through the alphabet (Z, Y, X, W ightarrow V). The numbers skip count forward by 10s (10, 20, 30, 40 ightarrow 50). Combining both gives V50.

faq.q: How many practice papers should I solve for CTET Paper 1 Maths?
faq.a: Aim for at least 15–30 full-length papers alongside chapter practice. The 30-paper e-book below gives 900 MCQs balanced across every chapter, each with answer keys and step-by-step solutions.
Yes, the 10-question mixed test on this page is completely free with instant scoring and explanations. For full-length practice, the linked e-book has 30 papers of 30 questions each.

faq.q: Does CTET Paper 1 Maths include pedagogy questions?
faq.a: Yes. Roughly half the section tests how children learn maths (pedagogy) alongside the content itself, so practise both.
